templates.template: Template Nvoip Softphone Push Route Guard
templates.name: Template Nvoip Softphone Push Route Guard
templates.description: NN-6117: route-specific 4xx, 5xx and 499 alerts for the softphone push gateway, using a status-only Nginx log.

items.name: Softphone push chat-message HTTP status
items.description: Reads the dedicated status-only Nginx log. No IP, query string, token or payload is collected.

triggers.expression: count(/Template Nvoip Softphone Push Route Guard/logrt[{$NVOIP.PUSH.LOG_PATH},"^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ /nvoip-softphone/push/chat-message [0-9]{3} [01]$",,,skip],5m,"regexp"," 5[0-9][0-9] [01]$")>0 or count(/Template Nvoip Softphone Push Route Guard/logrt[{$NVOIP.PUSH.LOG_PATH},"^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ /nvoip-softphone/push/chat-message [0-9]{3} [01]$",,,skip],5m,"regexp"," 499 1$")>0
triggers.name: Softphone push chat-message: HTTP 5xx or internal 499
triggers.description: Investigate Nginx and gateway logs for the affected route; correlate sent/failed before claiming delivery.

triggers.expression: count(/Template Nvoip Softphone Push Route Guard/logrt[{$NVOIP.PUSH.LOG_PATH},"^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ /nvoip-softphone/push/chat-message [0-9]{3} [01]$",,,skip],15m,"regexp"," 4[0-9][0-9] 1$")>0 and count(/Template Nvoip Softphone Push Route Guard/logrt[{$NVOIP.PUSH.LOG_PATH},"^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ /nvoip-softphone/push/chat-message [0-9]{3} [01]$",,,skip],15m,"regexp"," 1$")>0 and 2*count(/Template Nvoip Softphone Push Route Guard/logrt[{$NVOIP.PUSH.LOG_PATH},"^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ /nvoip-softphone/push/chat-message [0-9]{3} [01]$",,,skip],15m,"regexp"," 4[0-9][0-9] 1$")>=count(/Template Nvoip Softphone Push Route Guard/logrt[{$NVOIP.PUSH.LOG_PATH},"^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ /nvoip-softphone/push/chat-message [0-9]{3} [01]$",,,skip],15m,"regexp"," 1$")
triggers.name: Softphone push chat-message: at least 50% internal HTTP 4xx in 15m
triggers.description: Catches authorization or routing regressions even at low traffic; only known internal producers enter the ratio.

macros.description: Dedicated status-only log. The Zabbix agent must already have access without changing permissions of existing files.
